headline: Forces are pushes and pulls that make things change—nothing moves or stops without them
universal_truth: Change requires force; if nothing's pushing or pulling, nothing happens; to change anything, apply force
fun_facts: You can never touch anything—what you feel is electromagnetic force between atoms repelling each other
The force of gravity on Earth is approximately 9.8 meters per second squared
Your muscles can only pull, never push—even pushing movements use muscles pulling on bones
discussion_questions: What forces are acting on you right now?
What's pushing you toward your goals?

hook.title: Welcome
hook.script: Nothing moves without a push. Nothing stops without a pull. Forces are the invisible hands that shape everything—from planets orbiting to you lifting a cup. Understanding forces is understanding how anything changes at all.

options.text: I want to learn something new
options.response: Perfect. Curiosity is the first step to understanding. Let's explore this together.
That curiosity is exactly what we need. Let's dive in and discover something amazing.

cliff.title: The Question
cliff.script: Forces seem obvious—you push, something moves. But forces are everywhere, often invisible, always in balance or conflict. How do forces actually work?
cliff.prompt: What determines what happens when forces act?

options.text: The net result of all forces determines what happens—forces can add, cancel, or partially offset; what you see is the combined effect
options.response: Yes. Multiple forces act simultaneously. A tug-of-war is won not by who pulls, but by who pulls harder. Net force—the sum of all forces—determines the outcome.
Force matters, but direction matters too—opposing forces can cancel...

q1.title: Everything is Force
q1.script: Gravity pulls you down. The floor pushes you up. Friction slows you. Muscles move you. Even sitting still, forces balance perfectly. Remove any force and things change immediately.
q1.prompt: What's your first impression of "Everything is Force"?

options.text: This confirms what I already knew
options.response: Great foundation! Now let's build on that knowledge with something you might not expect...
Perfect starting point! This insight will connect to even more surprising facts ahead.

q2.title: Balanced vs Unbalanced
q2.script: When forces balance, nothing changes—you stay still or keep moving steadily. Unbalanced forces cause acceleration—speeding up, slowing down, changing direction. Change requires imbalance.
q2.prompt: How does this connect to what you already know?

options.response: Exactly. These connections are how knowledge becomes understanding.

options.text: I need to think about this more
options.response: That's a good instinct. Deep understanding takes time. The next fact will help clarify.

q3.title: Life Forces
q3.script: Your life has forces too. Motivation pushes forward. Fear pulls back. Habits carry momentum. Understanding the forces on you helps you change them—add allies, remove obstacles, shift direction.
q3.prompt: What surprises you most about this?

options.text: I never thought about it this way
options.response: That shift in perspective is exactly the point. New angles reveal new truths.
That's learning in action. When understanding shifts, you're really getting it.

wisdom.title: Today's Wisdom
wisdom.script: Here's today's wisdom: Change requires force. If nothing's pushing or pulling, nothing happens. To change anything, apply force—or remove what opposes it.
wisdom.prompt: What resonates most with you today?

options.response: That central truth will stay with you. Let it guide your thinking.
Application is where knowledge becomes wisdom. That's the real learning.

outro.title: See You Tomorrow
outro.script: That's Day 221. Tomorrow, we'll explore how things move—motion. Until then, identify the forces acting on something you want to change.
outro.prompt: Before you go—what will you take from today?

options.response: Reflection deepens learning. Let these ideas simmer in your mind.
Teaching others is the best way to learn. You've already begun the ripple.

growTrack.title: Force Diagram - What's Pushing and Pulling?
growTrack.activity: Pick a goal or situation you want to change. Draw a force diagram: what pushes toward the goal? What pulls against it? Which forces can you strengthen or weaken? Change comes from shifting the balance of forces.
